description: This file defines a JavaScript plugin for Bootstrap tabs, including the Tab class, its methods, and jQuery plugin registration. It manages tab activation, transitions, and event handling.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: A class representing a Bootstrap tab component, handling show and activation logic.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the selected tab, manages transition and event triggering.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a tab or pane, handling transition effects and updating classes.
